body: harness_board.py was the one subject in the kit with no mutant runner, and verify_board held it against ledgers that are green, so a renderer that summed of for n or rendered every engine good produced the same page and passed every check; measured on a copy, 121 of 121 with survived forced to zero. The obvious runner would have lied: every mutant that moves a byte dies at the byte-for-byte check and proves only that a byte moved. verify_board section 9 holds a fixture ledger set with every gate broken at known numbers, summary to 39 exact figures and render to the bytes of each row, 121 to 204. tools/mutate_board.py, 43 mutants, each re-rendering its own board before the suite runs so only a rule can kill it; a prose-only mutant survives it, which is the proof. 43 of 43 on the first honest run; the renderer had nothing wrong in it. Held: a second fixture with every gate met and a reading below its ceiling; trigger, the first mutant this runner misses.
subject: ADR-227: the board graded everything and was graded by nothing -- a mutant runner for the renderer, and a fixture ledger set with every gate broken
